alternatives.option: Build dist in the main checkout
alternatives.reason_rejected: violates A11; later v3 server changes would be served to unrelated sessions

context: Merged feat/cli-2.17 into foundation/v3 (conflict-free, tsc clean); opened draft PRs #48 (CLI → main, 2.17.0) and #49 (foundation/v3 → main, do-not-merge); fixed the CLI test suite's hard dependency on a prior dist build by bundling its entry per suite with esbuild.
rationale: The suite threw in beforeAll wherever dist/ had not been built — the main checkout by design (A11: its dist serves every session on this machine via the npm link). Bundling per suite mirrors the plugin bundle recipe, keeps the real-process exit-code test meaningful (same code path), and removes an `npm run build` precondition from the test contract.
summary: test/cli/twining.test.ts bundles src/cli/twining.ts with esbuild into node_modules/.cache/twining-cli-test/ in beforeAll (packages external, __TWINING_VERSION__ define) instead of spawning dist/cli/twining.js
